title: Coherence of ordinary and tensor chart comparison paths
statement: For schemes X,Y,Z, a triangle q:Y→X, p:Z→Y, q₀:Z→X with p≫q=q₀, an open cover U of X, an index a and one module F on X, the comparison paths from the iterated ordinary chart pullback of F to the restriction of the iterated tensor pullback agree. Define Uk=U.pullback₁(q), V=Uk.pullback₁(p), W=U.pullback₁(q₀). Let v:V(a)→W(a) be any morphism supplied with the first and second projection equations v≫W.f(a)=V.f(a) and v≫U.pullbackHom(q₀,a)=Uk.pullbackHom(p,a)≫U.pullbackHom(q,a) [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let d and b be supplied ordinary comparison isomorphisms, together with equalities identifying them with, respectively, the canonical ordinary composition comparison using the second projection, and the ordinary comparison from W.f(a)-pullback followed by v-pullback to V.f(a)-pullback using the first projection. With tq,tp,t₀ the open-cover comparisons [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison] and e the tensor compositor [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], pullback(Uk.pullbackHom(p,a)).map(tq.hom(F))≫tp.hom(tensorPullback(q)(F)) equals d.inv(pullback(U.f(a))(F))≫pullback(v).map(t₀.hom(F))≫b.hom(tensorPullback(q₀)(F))≫pullback(V.f(a)).map(e.hom(F)). There is no second module, morphism, ordinary chart map or recovery hypothesis.

proof.text: Substitute the two supplied equalities identifying d and b with their canonical compositions of pullbackComp and pullbackCongr. The refinement v and its two projection equations remain supplied data.

For each triangle arrow f write αf for the pinned leftAdjointUniq from tensorPullback f to ordinary pullback f. The mate definition of e identifies e with αq₀ followed by the inverse ordinary compositor (pullbackComp p q followed by pullbackCongr w), followed by the inverse αq and αp whiskered in the two factors. Each open-cover comparison is its ordinary composition path followed by the inverse αf whiskered with chart restriction. This follows by taking mates, using the pullback adjunction and the defining pushforward composition comparisons.

Substitute these descriptions. Ordinary pullback associativity (or leftAdjointCompIso_assoc after passing to pushforward mates) identifies the path through v,W.f(a),q₀ with the path through the two iterated chart projections and U.f(a). The two pullback-lift projection equations identify the composite scheme morphisms.

Equality induction identifies the pullbackCongr transports. Cancel adjacent inverse α comparisons and evaluate the resulting natural-transformation equality at F. This gives exactly the displayed objectwise identity. No recovery equation or morphism transport is used.

lean.statement:
theorem chart_tensor_pullback_comparison_coherence
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (q₀ : Z ⟶ X)
    (w : p ≫ q = q₀) (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (a : U.I₀) (F : X.Modules) :
    let Uk : Y.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
    let V : Z.OpenCover.{u} := Uk.pullback₁ p
    let W : Z.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q₀
    ∀ (v : V.X a ⟶ W.X a)
      (hv₁ : v ≫ W.f a = V.f a)
      (hv₂ : v ≫ U.pullbackHom q₀ a = Uk.pullbackHom p a ≫ U.pullbackHom q a),
    ∀ (d : Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback v ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pullback (Uk.pullbackHom p a)),
    d = Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp v (U.pullbackHom q₀ a) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hv₂ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Uk.pullbackHom p a) (U.pullbackHom q a)).symm →
    ∀ (b : Scheme.Modules.pullback (W.f a) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback v ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pullback (V.f a)),
    b = Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp v (W.f a) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hv₁ →
    let tq := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q U a
    let tp := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison p Uk a
    let t₀ := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison q₀ U a
    let e := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso p q q₀ w
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Uk.pullbackHom p a)).map (tq.hom.app F) ≫
        tp.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj F) =
      d.inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.f a)).obj F) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback v).map (t₀.hom.app F) ≫
        b.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj F) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V.f a)).map (e.hom.app F)
